logicalBugs.description: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. The Workflows list offers and confirms bulk Name updates, but submitting them always returns “Method not allowed” and leaves the selected workflows unchanged.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The generic bulk Update command is available for workflows, but workflow.updateMany has a pre-query hook that unconditionally throws Method not allowed, so every offered bulk rename fails.
reproductionPaths: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. The Workflows list offers and confirms bulk Name updates, but submitting them always returns “Method not allowed” and leaves the selected workflows unchanged.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Dragging a workflow configuration version or execution card to another status column can be correctly rejected while leaving the card in the requested column. The board falsely shows the attempted status until navigation or reload, even though the saved status never changed. This concerns the failed visual rollback, not permission to edit protected statuses.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Board dragging optimistically changes per-column record-ID membership before issuing the update. Workflow version/run hooks reject status writes, and rollback restores record fields without restoring those independent column memberships.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Dragging an Active workflow version into Deactivated is rejected, but the board leaves the card in Deactivated with a false status until navigation or refresh.

Twenty’s Workflow Runs history records individual executions of an automation. Drag a Workflow Run card from Failed to Completed on a status board. The server rejects the change, but the card stays in the Completed column until reload even though its saved status remains Failed.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. Leaving the Iterator settings panel within its one-second save delay silently discards pending input edits, including an input-array selection or deletion of a literal item. A lost array selection can make the workflow complete without processing the intended loop.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Iterator settings use a 1000ms debounced saveAction while updating local formData immediately; closing/switching the panel before it fires unmounts that owner without flushing pending edits.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. Leaving the Iterator settings panel within its one-second save delay silently discards pending input edits, including an input-array selection or deletion of a literal item. A lost array selection can make the workflow complete without processing the intended loop.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Discarding a workflow draft leaves an already-open Create Record editor showing discarded values. Editing another field spreads those stale values into a new draft, which can execute the discarded title or other mapping (a saved input value or reference).
logicalBugs.rootCause: WorkflowEditActionCreateRecord initializes formData from action.settings.input once and does not synchronize that local object when discard replaces the displayed version. Its next field update spreads the stale formData into the replacement draft. This confirmed local-state cause is separate from the Delay override report, whose editor has an explicit input synchronization effect.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Discarding a workflow draft leaves its open settings panel showing discarded values. Editing another field can save those stale values into a new draft and execute them.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Overriding an existing workflow draft from another version can leave the reopened Delay editor showing the discarded draft duration. Editing only a different duration field writes the old duration back into the replacement draft and persists it after reload.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Override Draft replaces persisted version content, but the returned editor can still supply the previous draft action snapshot to Delay. WorkflowEditActionDelay initializes from action.settings.input and explicitly resynchronizes localDuration whenever those duration props change, so an absence of local synchronization is ruled out. The stale snapshot must precede that input boundary; the precise override/navigation/cache ordering is not established by the available evidence. This is a source-informed hypothesis; the exact mechanism has not been confirmed in execution.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Choose Use as Draft on an older workflow version and Override Draft to replace an existing draft. The saved Delay duration is replaced correctly, but reopening the editor shows the old draft duration; editing another duration field writes that old value back.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. A rejected Delete on a workflow execution or version leaves its detail page falsely displaying a deleted record and Restore controls, although the record remains undeleted.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Generic record deletion optimistically sets deletedAt and deleted-record presentation before a request that workflow run/version pre-query hooks reject. Some record-show state remains in the deleted view even after the field rollback.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. A rejected Delete on a workflow execution or version leaves its detail page falsely displaying a deleted record and Restore controls, although the record remains undeleted.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. See Runs on a workflow version drops the selected version scope and shows executions from other versions. After a fresh version-page load it can also omit workflow scope and show unrelated workflows’ executions.
logicalBugs.rootCause: SeeRunsWorkflowVersion builds its second filter under recordStore instead of the WorkflowRun workflowVersion relation. The navigation filter cannot apply the selected version.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. See Runs on a workflow version drops the selected version scope and shows executions from other versions. After a fresh version-page load it can also omit workflow scope and show unrelated workflows’ executions.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Restoring a deleted draft workflow leaves its stored Statuses empty, so its table status is blank and Draft filtering excludes it even though the editor still shows Draft.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Workflow lifecycle restore undeletes child versions but does not rebuild the parent denormalized statuses from the restored draft, leaving the restored draft workflow outside Draft-filtered lists.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Restoring a deleted draft workflow leaves its stored Statuses empty, so its table status is blank and Draft filtering excludes it even though the editor still shows Draft.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Discard Draft retains the completed draft test execution, but its Flow becomes Invalid Configuration and its step-output inspection stops working.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Discard soft-deletes the draft WorkflowVersion; historical run inspection still asks the standard version-content query for that deleted version instead of consistently using the saved run.state.flow snapshot.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Discard Draft retains the completed draft test execution, but its Flow becomes Invalid Configuration and its step-output inspection stops working.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty uses selection dropdowns both for workflow inputs and for assigning permission roles. An unconfigured or no-longer-eligible Select value is displayed as the first available option without saving that choice. Workflow Form sources, Form answers, action mappings (saved input values or references) and time zones can therefore look configured but submit no value; role selectors can display a different role from the saved assignment. A sole unsaved option can also be disabled, preventing explicit selection.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Select derives selectedOption by matching value, then falls back to options[0] when no emptyOption is supplied. This fallback neither changes the stored value nor calls onChange. Its single-option disabled condition additionally treats the visually selected fallback as a real selection. Workflow and role callers pass unset or filtered-out values into this shared behavior.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Create Calendar Event action configures a meeting before creating it. Add a Create Calendar Event action without selecting a time zone. Its dropdown displays a specific time zone as though selected even though no time zone is stored; explicitly choosing a zone saves correctly.

Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. A workflow Form Select based on Opportunity (sales deal) Stage displays New as selected even when no value is set. Submitting it untouched completes without a Stage answer, while explicitly selecting the same New option submits NEW.

Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. In Update Record, add Stage under Fields to update without choosing a value. The selector displays New as selected although the saved action contains no Stage update; explicitly choosing New stores it correctly.

Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. Add Select or Multi-Select inputs to a workflow Form. Each source picker displays an existing record field as selected without saving that source, so the input is omitted from the running Form. When only one Multi-Select source exists, the disabled picker prevents explicitly selecting it.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Webhook trigger starts an automation from an incoming HTTP request. Choosing POST when the webhook method is already POST overwrites a saved custom Expected Body with defaults, while the editor continues displaying the old JSON.
logicalBugs.rootCause: HTTP method onChange replaces settings with getWebhookTriggerDefaultSettings even when POST is reselected. Expected Body is reset, while the mounted JSON editor retains its previously initialized text.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Webhook trigger starts an automation from an incoming HTTP request. Choosing POST when the webhook method is already POST overwrites a saved custom Expected Body with defaults, while the editor continues displaying the old JSON.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. Selecting a workflow in a freshly loaded Workflows list and clicking See Runs can open the unfiltered workspace execution list, including executions from unrelated workflows.
logicalBugs.rootCause: SeeRuns derives its workflow filter from asynchronous useWorkflowWithCurrentVersion rather than the already selected recordId. Initial render can navigate with an undefined selected workflow ID.
reproductionPaths: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. Selecting a workflow in a freshly loaded Workflows list and clicking See Runs can open the unfiltered workspace execution list, including executions from unrelated workflows.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Webhook trigger starts an automation from an incoming HTTP request. Workflow variable expressions cannot reliably reference literal object keys containing dots or slashes. Picker-selected values can resolve a different nested property or no value, producing incorrect action inputs.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Workflow variable expressions encode object property names as dot/slash-delimited paths without an escaping scheme. Literal dotted or slash-containing keys are parsed as path structure and resolve to nested data or no value.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Webhook trigger starts an automation from an incoming HTTP request. The webhook variable picker separately offers a literal customer.name key, but selecting it maps the nested customer > name field and creates a Note with the wrong title.

Twenty’s Webhook trigger starts an automation from an incoming HTTP request. The variable picker offers a nonempty webhook field named a/b, but mapping it to Create Record Notes Body creates a saved Note with no selected content.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty can trigger an automation when records of a chosen type are created or updated. Changing a database trigger to another object preserves incompatible old conditions and monitored fields. Pickers can show the former object input structure, and activation or execution can retain conditions that do not belong to the new object.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Changing the database trigger object updates eventName while preserving old filter and monitored-field settings. Pickers/cache can retain the former schema or hide unresolved names, and activation does not reject references incompatible with the new object.
reproductionPaths: Twenty can trigger an automation when records of a chosen type are created or updated. Changing a record trigger from Workflows to Companies leaves existing Conditions field pickers offering Workflow fields and prevents selecting Company fields until the panel is reopened.

Twenty can trigger an automation when records of a chosen type are created or updated. Changing a Record-updated trigger from Notes to Companies retains the old Title condition after reload; it displays Select a field and the active workflow does not execution on Company updates.

Twenty can trigger an automation when records of a chosen type are created or updated. Changing a Record is updated trigger from Companies to People retains Company-only monitored fields while showing an empty Fields selector, silently preventing later People updates from starting the workflow.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s HTTP Request action sends a configured request, including a URL, headers and optional body. HTTP Request actions receiving an HTTP 404 or 500 response can be saved as successful steps and mark the workflow Completed; later actions execute even with Continue on failure disabled.
logicalBugs.rootCause: HttpTool catches HTTP failures and returns an object containing error/status rather than throwing. The workflow action/executor interprets the resolved result as successful and schedules following steps.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s HTTP Request action sends a configured request, including a URL, headers and optional body. HTTP Request actions receiving an HTTP 404 or 500 response can be saved as successful steps and mark the workflow Completed; later actions execute even with Continue on failure disabled.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty can divide table rows or board cards into groups based on a field value. Alphabetical and Reverse Alphabetical group ordering works immediately in grouped Table and Kanban (a board of cards in columns) views but resets to Manual after reload, including Opportunity (sales deal) Stage, Task Status and Workflow Runs (execution history) views.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The group-order menu updates an in-memory component state defaulting to Manual. Column ordering reads it, but view persistence and loading omit that setting. Neighboring visibility settings use stored view fields.
reproductionPaths: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. Reverse Alphabetical group ordering in a custom Workflow Runs (execution history) view resets to Manual after refresh, even after an explicit Update view save completes.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty can divide table rows or board cards into groups based on a field value. Record-list header counts and grouped Table calculations can disagree with the rows that are displayed. Combining search, field filters or group conditions can leave summaries counting excluded records; in a Workflow Runs (execution history) table, linked-record grouping can instead show matching rows with a zero total. These cases concern incorrect summaries, not missing saved records.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Table footer and header aggregate hooks combine independently compiled filters using object spread. Group, explicit filters and any-field search can each contain top-level and/or keys; later objects replace earlier predicates rather than conjoining them, so summaries include records excluded by the row query.
reproductionPaths: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. Group a saved Workflow Runs table by Workflow or Workflow version without configured group based on a linked records. Matching execution rows are displayed, but the total count is zero.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty stores the inputs, outputs and configured steps for each workflow execution. Change the current draft’s webhook sample fields, then open an earlier successful execution without reloading the app. Its read-only Node tab marks a previously valid input reference Not Found, even though that execution’s saved input and output are correct; reloading the execution page restores the label.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Historical run variable labels are resolved against current editable workflow steps/output schema rather than the run saved flow snapshot. Renamed/deleted steps in the current version make valid historical references appear Not Found.
reproductionPaths: Twenty stores the inputs, outputs and configured steps for each workflow execution. Change the current draft’s webhook sample fields, then open an earlier successful execution without reloading the app. Its read-only Node tab marks a previously valid input reference Not Found, even though that execution’s saved input and output are correct; reloading the execution page restores the label.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Webhook trigger starts an automation from an incoming HTTP request. Webhook Test replaces nonempty sample fields named payload and metadata with internal trigger context, so picker-selected values create Notes with blank or incorrect content.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Webhook test payload construction merges test metadata and supplied expected body with conflicting reserved keys, overwriting user-provided payload/metadata values rather than namespacing the synthetic fields.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Webhook trigger starts an automation from an incoming HTTP request. Webhook Test replaces nonempty sample fields named payload and metadata with internal trigger context, so picker-selected values create Notes with blank or incorrect content.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s schedule trigger starts an automation at configured recurring times. Schedule intervals expressed as every N hours or days reset at calendar boundaries instead of preserving the requested elapsed interval. The retained interval and human-readable summary can disagree with upcoming trigger times.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Schedule interval conversion encodes hours/days as cron */N fields. Cron restarts those fields each day/month instead of representing elapsed N-hour/N-day intervals, so advertised durations such as 25 hours or calendar-boundary days are not preserved.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s schedule trigger starts an automation at configured recurring times. Hours between triggers accepts and retains 25, but the generated cron (recurring-schedule) schedule previews daily occurrences while the summary promises every 25 hours.
Twenty’s schedule trigger starts an automation at configured recurring times. A saved three-day schedule preview crosses a month boundary with a one-day gap despite its every three days summary.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Duplicating a supported workflow without stored action positions, including seeded Quick Lead, gives copied action nodes the same canvas position so they obscure one another.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Whole-workflow cloning copies per-step saved positions/default positions rather than reproducing the currently computed automatic layout, so duplicated actions stack when the source positions existed only in rendered layout.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Duplicate a preloaded workflow whose action positions were not saved. The copied steps share the same diagram position and cover one another instead of reproducing the original visible layout.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty workflow editors include date pickers for Form answers and Delay settings. At mobile and tablet widths, workflow Date and DateTime calendars can open beneath the fixed Form or Delay side panel, hiding the calendar and preventing day selection.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The date/datetime floating picker portal does not establish a stacking level above the fixed mobile workflow/command panel. Its mounted calendar is painted beneath the panel despite being interactive in desktop context.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. At viewport widths up to 768 pixels, a workflow Form Date calendar opens beneath the fixed form panel, preventing calendar day selection.
Twenty’s Delay action can wait until a chosen date and time. The Delay date/time calendar opens beneath the mobile editor panel, preventing calendar selection while typed date entry still works.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Changing an existing or placeholder workflow action to If/Else or Iterator saves companion nodes but omits them from the live diagram until reload. Adding routes or another step can then error or crash the editor.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The action type-change service persists additionalCreatedSteps for complex If/Else and Iterator replacements but returns only updatedStep. useUpdateWorkflowVersionStep replaces that controller in client flow/cache without adding the saved companion nodes. The live diagram is therefore incomplete until reload; subsequent insertion traverses this incomplete graph. This is distinct from the persistent transient-ID Iterator return defect.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Change an existing workflow action to If/Else. Generated branch placeholders are saved but missing from the live diagram until reload; adding a route errors and adding another step can crash the editor.

Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Convert an existing branch or loop-child placeholder to Iterator, then insert a Filter or Create Record step. The editor can be replaced by a recoverable error page rather than showing the inserted step.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Delay inspectors that show a read-only execution, active version or archived version still expose Delete and Duplicate. Using those controls can change a separate editable draft, sometimes while reporting an error, instead of leaving the read-only inspection unchanged. The published or historical version itself remains unchanged.
logicalBugs.rootCause: WorkflowEditActionDelay disables its inputs for readonly views but always renders WorkflowStepFooter without a readonly guard. Delete/Duplicate therefore obtain an updatable current draft even when invoked from a historical/active inspector.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Delay inspectors in completed executions and archived workflow versions expose Delete and Duplicate despite being read-only. These actions create or change the current workflow draft instead of editing the displayed historical step diagram.

Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Duplicate node in a read-only active-version Delay inspector reports an error while persisting a duplicate into a hidden current or new draft.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. The Workflows list offers Activate and Deactivate with multiple eligible workflows selected, but each command changes only the first selected workflow in table order.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Activate/Deactivate commands are offered with multi-selection but each implementation takes selectedRecords[0] and invokes the single-workflow mutation once.
reproductionPaths: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. The Workflows list offers Activate and Deactivate with multiple eligible workflows selected, but each command changes only the first selected workflow in table order.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Iterator repeats child steps for each item in a list. Creating it by changing an existing step type or choosing it in a branch placeholder saves an invalid loop-return connection. If that Iterator is selected, execution can fail after its first item; if it is on an unused branch, it can instead prevent the selected sibling branch from starting while the execution reports Completed. Directly adding an otherwise equivalent Iterator works.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Type replacement creates an Iterator with a fresh transient ID and constructs its loop return referencing that ID, then overrides only the controller ID with the existing placeholder ID. Loop references still point at the absent transient controller, breaking iteration or skipped-path continuation.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. Choose Iterator in a branch placeholder, or change an existing action to Iterator, and save a two-item input list. The created loop has an invalid return connection: the first item executions, then execution fails before the second. A directly added Iterator works.

Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. Create an Iterator from the unused branch placeholder of an If/Else (a step choosing between conditional paths) step. Even when the other branch is selected, its Delay never starts while the overall execution reports Completed; the skipped Iterator has a broken loop-return connection.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. After a workflow page is loaded while the workflow is deleted, Restore succeeds and removes the deleted banner but leaves the editor blank and Test/Activate unavailable until reload or navigation.
logicalBugs.rootCause: A workflow initially loaded as deleted skips/omits editable flow setup. Restoring it updates record deletion state without reinitializing the flow/diagram content, so the editor remains blank until a fresh mount.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. After a workflow page is loaded while the workflow is deleted, Restore succeeds and removes the deleted banner but leaves the editor blank and Test/Activate unavailable until reload or navigation.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. A form Select field persists its custom Label setting in the editor but renders the underlying record type’s field name at runtime.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The workflow Form select renderer forwards the input type/default choices but does not consistently pass the configured label into the underlying single/multi-select field, so runtime labels are missing.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. A form Select field persists its custom Label setting in the editor but renders the underlying record type’s field name at runtime.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Duplicate Workflow assigns copied actions new identities but leaves branch destinations and action-input variable references pointing to original actions. Branch copies report Completed without running either branch, and copied Iterator inputs show Not Found.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Whole-workflow duplication remaps trigger/nextStepIds and Iterator loop starts but not every branch settings reference or variable-expression step ID. Copied branches/mappings still refer to the original workflow graph.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Duplicate Workflow assigns copied actions new identities but leaves branch destinations and action-input variable references pointing to original actions. Branch copies report Completed without running either branch, and copied Iterator inputs show Not Found.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Adding a step to the seeded active Quick Lead workflow fails in the frontend, leaves the picker open, and crashes on retry. Reload reveals both nodes persisted, so the failed UI encourages duplicate steps.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Adding Delay from an active workflow first creates/targets an editable draft but the insertion response is applied to a flow/cache still representing the active version. The failed transition leaves incompatible version/step state for retry.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Add a Delay step to the preloaded active example workflow. An error leaves the picker open with no visible new step; trying again crashes the editor. Reload shows both steps were actually saved into its draft.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. Submitting valid workflow form input successfully completes the workflow but also produces two false 'Invalid workflow operation.' error toasts.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Form submission resumes workflow execution but also invokes generic record-update lifecycle paths against workflow run/version records whose pre-query hooks forbid those mutations, emitting invalid-operation errors after the supported form resume succeeds.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. Submitting valid workflow form input successfully completes the workflow but also produces two false 'Invalid workflow operation.' error toasts.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Use as Draft can present the wrong existing-draft confirmation or fail to open it after navigating between workflow versions or activating another version in a second tab. One path repeatedly reports that a modal is already active; another claims a draft exists while Go to Draft opens the older settings that were requested. These are confirmation/context failures, not a demonstrated loss of the restored settings.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Use-as-Draft confirmation derives its existing draft/context from cached workflow versions and a captured selected version. Returning between draft/version views can leave that command context stale, producing a failed confirmation or warning about the draft it has just opened.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. With an existing workflow draft, use Go to Draft, return to the active version and choose Use as Draft again. A modal-already-active error replaces the expected Cancel, Go to Draft and Override Draft choices, and retrying repeats the error.

Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Activate a newer workflow version in another browser tab, then choose Use as Draft on an older version. The dialog can falsely say a draft already exists even though Go to Draft opens the older settings that were requested.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. Choosing None in Group by does not remove grouping in Workflow Versions or Workflow Runs views when their saved group list is empty; the previous grouping and selector choice remain active.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The group reset handler returns early when saved viewGroups is empty even if mainGroupByFieldMetadataId is set. None cannot clear grouping for relation/status views with no generated groups.
reproductionPaths: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. Group a Workflow Versions Table by Version status, then select None in Group by. Status sections remain visible and the menu still marks Version status selected instead of showing an ungrouped list.

Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. Group a Workflow Runs Table by Workflow or Workflow version, then choose None. The selected grouping remains saved after reload; switching first to execution-status grouping and then None clears it.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Workflow Create Record and Update Record actions fail to persist explicit clears. No Status can create a default-status record, and No record or cleared date, amount and other nullable inputs can leave the existing value unchanged.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The record CRUD cleanup helper removeUndefinedFromRecord uses isDefined and recursively removes null as well as undefined. Explicit No Status, No record, date/currency/amount clears are omitted from create/update payloads, activating defaults or retaining old values.
reproductionPaths: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. The workflow Create Record action displays No Status when Status is unset, yet creates To do tasks. Explicitly choosing No Status also creates To do tasks instead of a task with no status.

Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. In Update Record, explicitly clear Company Annual Revenue Amount Micros while changing its currency. The saved action has a blank amount, but a successful execution retains the previous amount and changes only the currency; explicitly setting zero works.

Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. In a Task Update Record action, explicitly choose No Status and let it save. Execution reports success but leaves the Task’s previous status; selecting a nonempty status updates it correctly.

Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Save No record for a Person’s Company in Update Record, then execute the workflow. It reports success but the Person remains linked to the previous Company; choosing a different Company works.

Twenty’s Delay action pauses an automation for a duration or until a specified date and time. Clear a Task Due Date in Update Record and let that empty setting save. Successful execution leaves the Task’s old date unchanged, while setting another date works.

Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Save No currency for an existing Company revenue value in Update Record. The step reports success but retains the previous currency; explicitly selecting another currency works.

Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. In Company Update Record, select Account Owner for update and choose No record. The saved clear is ignored during a successful execution, leaving the previous owner on the refreshed Company; assigning another owner or updating Name works.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. With the Workflows list filtered to a single eligible workflow, header Select all hides working commands that selecting the same row individually exposes.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Select-all represents selection through the all-records mode rather than an explicit single-record selection. Workflow commands require an explicit selected record/current version and are hidden even when the entire eligible result contains only one workflow.
reproductionPaths: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. With the Workflows list filtered to a single eligible workflow, header Select all hides working commands that selecting the same row individually exposes.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Leaving pending recipient text by clicking Subject moves focus back to the recipient editor, so subsequent subject text is saved as To recipients.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Recipient and Subject variable-friendly fields reuse shared editor/focus identifiers and focus initialization; focusing Subject can leave the active text-editor target on the recipient input, routing subsequent typing there.
reproductionPaths: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Leaving pending recipient text by clicking Subject moves focus back to the recipient editor, so subsequent subject text is saved as To recipients.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Permanently destroying a Workflow leaves its deleted detail page visible with Restore controls that cannot recover the destroyed record.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Destroying the record from another view does not invalidate the already-open deleted detail record. The detail page keeps its cached deleted entity and Restore affordance even though permanent destruction removed the backend record.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Permanently destroy a deleted Workflow from its record page. Destruction succeeds, but the old page continues offering Restore, which cannot recover the destroyed workflow.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. The Form builder's visible Reorder field grip does not start dragging or change field order; dragging the label or field body works and persists the new order.
logicalBugs.rootCause: FormBuilder wires a draggable list and drag result handler, but the settings grip is rendered inside field/settings controls without preserving the draggable handle event contract, so dragging the visible handle does not produce a committed order change.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. The Form builder's visible Reorder field grip does not start dragging or change field order; dragging the label or field body works and persists the new order.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty can show commands as pinned header buttons or inside a command menu. After a desktop record or workflow surface is resized to tablet or mobile layout, eligible actions disappear from both the pinned toolbar and the default command menu. Searching or reloading restores actions such as Test, Deactivate, See Runs and Company commands.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Mobile unmounts the pinned toolbar measurement producer, but shared inline-layout state retains desktop widths. The default menu incorrectly excludes actions it believes remain inline.
reproductionPaths: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. After resizing a desktop workflow editor to tablet width, its default command menu omits Test, Deactivate and See Runs; reloading at the same width restores the commands.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Deletion deactivates an active workflow on the server, but its open record can retain the Active badge both while deleted and after restoration until its data is reloaded.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Server deletion deactivates workflows and updates parent statuses, but the generic client deletion/restore cache update changes deletedAt without applying the corresponding status changes, leaving Active displayed until refetch.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Deletion deactivates an active workflow on the server, but its open record can retain the Active badge both while deleted and after restoration until its data is reloaded.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Typing a negative fraction digit by digit into workflow numeric inputs loses the minus sign at the intermediate -0, saving a positive value. This affects Form answers, Code inputs and filter operands; entering the complete negative value at once works.
logicalBugs.rootCause: FormNumberFieldInput parses each intermediate text update to a number. Typing -0 during a negative fraction becomes negative zero; synchronization reconstructs it with String(defaultValue), losing the sign before later fractional digits are entered.
reproductionPaths: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Type a negative fraction between minus one and zero into a workflow Form Number field one character at a time. The minus sign disappears at the intermediate -0, so the answer becomes positive; entering the complete number at once works.

Twenty’s Code workflow action uses a function with configurable inputs and outputs. Sequential typing of a Code parameter between -1 and 0 converts its intermediate -0 to 0, saving the completed number with the wrong sign.

Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Sequentially typing a negative fraction such as -0.4 into a numeric Filter threshold can display and save 0.4. Reopening after reload retains the positive value on two fresh workflows. An execution using the incorrectly positive threshold evaluates differently from the corrected negative control.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty workflow settings and Forms use date inputs with a typed date/time template. Clearing or partially replacing a workflow date by typing changes its visible mask without updating the stored value or required-field state. Reopening can restore the old date, submission can use that old value, and resetting an already-empty field can leave stale visible text; the explicit Clear command works.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The masked date input keeps incomplete/cleared text locally and calls its parent only for completed dates. The parent retains its previous/null value, so clearing or partially replacing visible text neither clears persisted values nor blocks submission, and resetting an already-null parent does not clear the local mask.
reproductionPaths: Twenty workflow settings and Forms use date inputs with a typed date/time template. Deleting all text in a saved Calendar or Delay date field leaves an empty mask but never saves the removal; ordinary reopening restores the old date, while the picker's Clear command works.

Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. Editing a previously valid Form Date to an impossible or incomplete date leaves that new text visible, but Submit silently stores the previous valid date as the answer.
Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. Clear closes the date picker but retains incomplete date text in an initially empty workflow Form input.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. A workflow test side panel stops updating when a pending execution is left on Home or a step Output inspector. Home can remain Running with no end time and Delay Output can remain Empty Object after successful completion; returning through Flow or reopening reveals the saved result, while the full execution page updates live.
logicalBugs.rootCause: WorkflowRunCard mounts WorkflowRunSSESubscribeEffect with the Flow widget. Home and SidePanelWorkflowRunViewStep replace that mounted owner but read the cached run without mounting a replacement subscriber. The opened snapshot therefore has no continuing run-event owner until Flow is revisited; the full run page retains its Flow subscription. This is a source-informed hypothesis; the exact mechanism has not been confirmed in execution.
reproductionPaths: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. Opening a workflow test execution's Home tab while a Delay executions leaves the panel showing Running and a blank end time after completion; the same execution's full page shows Completed.

Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. A Delay Output inspector opened while a test execution is pending stays at Empty Object after successful completion; reopening reveals the saved result.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Delete an Else-if route from a conditional If/Else step. Its settings and connecting arrow disappear, but the saved Filter action for that route remains as a disconnected step on the diagram.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Deleting an Else-if route removes the branch link without removing/reconnecting its saved Filter action node. The generic diagram builder still renders that retained action as disconnected.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Deleting an Else if route removes its settings and edge but leaves its Filter action disconnected on the workflow canvas.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. After restoring an archived version as a draft and discarding that draft, Versions shows a count of two with only one version row.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Workflow version list and header aggregate count use different visibility/filter treatment for draft/deleted/current versions, so the count includes a version omitted from the visible rows.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. After restoring an archived version as a draft and discarding that draft, Versions shows a count of two with only one version row.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Importing a workflow list CSV exported from the same workspace replaces the existing workflow step diagram with an empty draft.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Generic workflow CSV reimport carries exported record metadata but not the executable graph contract. The workflow update/draft creation path treats omitted steps as an empty draft and replaces the original content rather than preserving it.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Importing a workflow list CSV exported from the same workspace replaces the existing workflow step diagram with an empty draft.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. A workflow Form advertises Ctrl+Enter beside Submit, but that shortcut leaves valid answers unsubmitted while clicking Submit succeeds.
logicalBugs.rootCause: WorkflowStepCmdEnterButton registers Ctrl/Meta+Enter only on SIDE_PANEL_FOCUS_ID. Focus held by an input/editor can keep that panel-scoped handler from receiving the shortcut although the button tooltip advertises it.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. A workflow Form advertises Ctrl+Enter beside Submit, but that shortcut leaves valid answers unsubmitted while clicking Submit succeeds.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. A workflow Form shortcut bypasses the disabled Submit button: after an invalid Number answer, clicking blank panel space and pressing Ctrl+Enter completes the execution with missing or previously valid answers despite the visible validation error.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The shortcut callback invokes onClick unconditionally; disabled is applied only to the rendered Button and is absent from the hotkey registration/dependencies. After focus leaves an invalid Number input, Ctrl+Enter can bypass the disabled Submit gate.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. A workflow Form displays Invalid number and disables Submit, but clicking blank space in the Form panel and pressing Ctrl+Enter completes the execution with an empty result. Two fresh executions reproduce on one saved workflow. A valid button submission returns its entered numbers.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Send Email and Code action editors can expand to fullscreen. Mobile Back breadcrumb (page navigation link)s in fullscreen Send Email and Code editors fail to close fullscreen mode, leaving the expanded editor over its parent settings.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Expanded Send Email/Code passes placeholder breadcrumb hrefs while only the desktop X has the fullscreen close callback. MobileBreadcrumb renders a normal Link, so Back navigation does not reset fullscreen state.
reproductionPaths: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. The expanded Send Email Body editor remains open after its Back to Send Email link is clicked at mobile width.
Twenty’s Code action editor can expand to fullscreen. The expanded Code editor remains fullscreen after its mobile Back link is clicked.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. The workflow execution Input inspector can show the first loop result instead of the final result for a completed later step, or crash when inspecting later nested-pass through the loops. The execution itself can complete successfully; the failure concerns historical input reconstruction.
logicalBugs.rootCause: getWorkflowRunStepContext selects every prior step history using one flat currentLoopIterationIndex until it encounters an Iterator, then uses index 0. It dereferences the chosen history entry without checking availability. This cannot map nested per-ancestor iteration histories and chooses the oldest history when a downstream step has no selected-loop index, producing either wrong inputs or an absent-entry exception.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. Open the last item’s Output in a completed nested Iterator execution and switch to Input. The workflow page is replaced by an error screen instead of showing that iteration’s inputs.

Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. After a two-item Iterator finishes, its completed-branch Delay Input tab shows the first iteration values even though execution used the final completed Iterator result.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. Answers entered in a running workflow Form can disappear when its side panel is replaced or switches between desktop and mobile layouts. Opening a selected Company link and returning clears the answers; resizing can also discard saved answers and allow submission with empty output. This is loss through ordinary panel transitions rather than a hard reload interrupting configuration autosave.
logicalBugs.rootCause: WorkflowEditActionFormFiller initializes formData from action.settings.input. useUpdateWorkflowRunStep saves answers and updates the workflowRun cache, but does not update the separate flowComponentState used to render the test panel. The opening effect seeds that flow snapshot once; remounting the Form then reads stale action input. The filler flushes its debounce on cleanup, so a generic unflushed callback alone does not explain this loss. This is a source-informed hypothesis; the exact mechanism has not been confirmed in execution.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. Select a Company in a running workflow Form, open that Company’s record link and return with panel Back. Every entered Form answer is cleared without warning.

Twenty’s Form workflow action collects user answers before the automation continues. Fill a pending workflow Test Form, then resize across the desktop/mobile layout boundary. Previously saved answers can disappear, and Submit can complete with empty output.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty displays workflow steps and their connections in an interactive diagram. Workflow diagrams retain an obsolete canvas position after viewport or navigation changes, or opening an execution on its full page. Steps and labels can be clipped or entirely hidden despite remaining present; panning or reloading at the final layout reveals them.
logicalBugs.rootCause: WorkflowDiagramCanvasBase centers/translates the graph from container offsetWidth during initialization and selected panel transitions, without a resize-driven re-fit when responsive navigation/panels change container geometry. The canvas can remain clipped or offscreen until remount.
reproductionPaths: Twenty displays workflow steps and their connections in an interactive diagram. A visible workflow step diagram becomes blank after the editor is narrowed from desktop to mobile; reloading at the same mobile size restores it.

Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. The full Workflow Run Flow page keeps an obsolete horizontal diagram position after a tablet navigation drawer is collapsed or a 768px execution page narrows to 390px, clipping step labels and completion marks.

Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. On two executions at 1440 by 1000, opening the full execution page left its left branch completely behind the details panel and upstream nodes partly covered. Panning revealed the nodes.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s schedule trigger starts an automation at configured recurring times. Typing the custom monthly cron expression (text specifying a recurring schedule) 0 12 1 * * initially shows a yearly January 12 preview instead of noon on the first day of each month. Reload retains the expression and restores the correct monthly description and upcoming times.
logicalBugs.rootCause: CronExpressionHelper computes the description and upcoming occurrences from the currently edited cron expression and timezone. The reported first-edit preview disagrees with the persisted expression but rebuilds correctly after reload, locating the failure in preview parsing or its synchronization with edited text. The specific token-normalization or update-order mechanism is not established by the retained source evidence. This is a source-informed hypothesis; the exact mechanism has not been confirmed in execution.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s schedule trigger starts an automation at configured recurring times. After typing the monthly cron expression (text specifying a recurring schedule), its initial schedule preview shows a different yearly schedule; reload restores the correct preview.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Clear the numeric value in an If/Else condition or Filter action. The input shows the literal text null instead of an empty field, and typing a replacement appends to that text rather than replacing a clean empty value.
logicalBugs.rootCause: FormNumberFieldInput emits real null for an empty numeric input. WorkflowStepFilterValueInput converts non-string primitive values with String(value), turning null into the four-character string null and saving it as the condition value.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Clearing an If/Else or Filter numeric condition produces the literal text null, so typing a replacement appends to invalid text instead of starting from an empty input.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Workflow text inputs can display a different value from the action’s saved configuration. Changing a comparison operator or reselecting its field can save an empty comparison while showing the old text, causing execution to use the hidden empty value; a Code parameter edited in fullscreen can save correctly while its sidebar still shows the old text.
logicalBugs.rootCause: useTextVariableEditor initializes editor content once from defaultValue and does not synchronize later prop changes. Operator/field resets and fullscreen edits change saved state while the mounted editor still displays the previous string.
reproductionPaths: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Changing a string comparison operator clears the saved value while the If/Else (a step choosing between conditional paths) or Filter input continues to display the previous value, concealing the configuration used by execution.

Twenty’s Code workflow action uses a function with configurable inputs and outputs. Editing a Code action text parameter in fullscreen saves correctly but leaves its still-mounted sidebar input displaying the previous text.

Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Reselecting the current field can conceal an empty saved comparison and make a workflow Filter execute differently from its visible condition.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. A completed short workflow test can leave its Flow panel displaying Running until its data is reloaded.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Two independently captured races can freeze the same Flow status: live-listener registration after a short run finishes, or an older RUNNING query response overwriting a newer terminal live update in the cache.
reproductionPaths: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. A completed short workflow test can leave its Flow panel displaying Running until its data is reloaded.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty opens a name editor when a Note, Task or workflow is first created. Reloading the initial page of a newly created Note, Task or workflow can reopen its name editor with an empty draft despite a saved title. Committing that empty draft through ordinary clicking or keyboard navigation erases the saved name. The accepted Note case can also occur when reopening it from its Company Timeline after the creation-page reload.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The creation flag retained in router history reopens the new-record title editor after reload. useOpenNewRecordTitleCell initializes its draft from the record store before the fetched title is available; commit handlers persist this empty draft.
reproductionPaths: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. Reloading a freshly created workflow’s landing page opens an empty title draft; an ordinary canvas click or Tab then overwrites its saved name.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Delay action pauses an automation for a duration or until a specified date and time. A standalone Delay left at its default all-zero duration fails the workflow with an internal pending-state error instead of completing immediately.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The Delay action queues an immediately runnable resume job before the executor persists PENDING. The resume worker treats a non-PENDING step as fatal and ends the run; termination supplies the displayed step error.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Delay action pauses an automation for a duration or until a specified date and time. A standalone Delay left at its default all-zero duration fails the workflow with an internal pending-state error instead of completing immediately.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Delay action pauses an automation for a duration or until a specified date and time. A Delay with no following step on its path resumes and completes the entire execution while parallel work remains, failing unfinished steps and omitting later actions.
logicalBugs.rootCause: After a Delay resumes successfully, the resume job ends the run Completed when that step has no next IDs, bypassing normal keep-running computation. Ending the run preserves Completed while failing unfinished steps.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Delay action pauses an automation for a duration or until a specified date and time. A Delay with no following step on its path resumes and completes the entire execution while parallel work remains, failing unfinished steps and omitting later actions.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. Use the advertised Remove variable control on a record reference in Delete Record or Update Record. The configured reference remains saved and unchanged instead of being removed.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The enabled chip receives an onRemove wrapper, but its picker forwards removal only to optional onClear. Delete Record and Update Record omit onClear, whereas Create or Update Record supplies it.
reproductionPaths: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. The advertised Remove variable control leaves saved record mappings (saved input values or references) unchanged in Delete Record and Update Record.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. A Filter that skips a nested Iterator prevents its completion handoff to the outer loop, leaving the server execution Running and later actions unstarted.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The skipped Iterator returns loop-body IDs but omits completed-path children, preventing the handoff back to the outer loop. Keep-running logic retains Running because the outer Iterator remains active.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. A Filter that skips a nested Iterator prevents its completion handoff to the outer loop, leaving the server execution Running and later actions unstarted.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Insert an If/Else step on an existing connection arrow between actions. Its new branches are not connected back to the actions that originally followed the arrow, leaving the saved continuation unusable.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Generic insertion assigns the previous successor to the inserted node’s nextStepIds, but If/Else construction creates empty branch nodes without that continuation. Rendering and execution follow the branches rather than the generic successor.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Edge insertion of If/Else fails to connect its new branches to the previously connected later actions, persisting an unusable continuation.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s schedule trigger starts an automation at configured recurring times. Schedule fields accept and save fractional values even where an integer is required. A saved fractional hour can break the upcoming-times preview; activating an invalid fractional schedule can leave the workflow marked Active without a working scheduled trigger, and replacing a schedule can also remove its previous working trigger.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Cron preset forms validate positive numeric bounds but not integer values. Fractional hours/durations are saved into cron configuration, and activation persists active version status before trigger registration can reject the invalid cron, without rolling those writes back.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s schedule trigger starts an automation at configured recurring times. Activating a saved fractional schedule fails cron (recurring-schedule) validation after persisting Active status, without registering a trigger; replacement can also remove a working prior trigger.

Twenty’s schedule trigger starts an automation at configured recurring times. Enter a fractional hour in a schedule field that says it requires an integer. The fraction saves and remains after reload, and the invalid value prevents the upcoming-times preview from working.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Delay action pauses an automation for a duration or until a specified date and time. Select or remove a variable used for a Delay duration. The visible choice changes, but leaving the panel through normal navigation and reopening it restores the old value because the edit was not saved. This concerns the variable choice, not ordinary numeric duration entry.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Duration onChange updates localDuration, while its commit path is the inner text input’s onBlur. Variable insertion and removal call onChange without ensuring that the changed duration is subsequently committed.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Delay action can take a duration from an earlier workflow value rather than a typed number. Select or remove that variable: the visible choice changes, but reopening the panel restores the previously saved number or variable even after waiting. This affects both choosing a new reference and removing a saved one.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. Inspect a workflow step that succeeded on an earlier loop item but was Skipped on its latest item. Output is disabled even when the user selects the earlier successful iteration, preventing inspection of its stored result. The result exists; the tab uses the wrong execution status to decide availability.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Output-tab gating reads the step’s latest status while output content reads the selected iteration history. A latest Skipped status disables Output for successful earlier histories.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. Run inspection gates Output on the latest step status, blocking stored results from successful earlier iterations when the final iteration was skipped.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Discard an editable draft, later delete its parent workflow and restore that workflow. Restoration also revives the previously discarded draft and can select it as the current draft. The failure is resurrection of a version discarded before deletion, rather than loss of the version that was active when deleted.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Discard soft-deletes versions. Parent restoration unconditionally undeletes child versions by workflowId and re-mirrors them, including drafts deleted earlier for an independent discard reason. Current-version selection then chooses a restored draft.
reproductionPaths: Twenty saves automation configurations in versions; a draft is editable and an Active version is published. Parent workflow restoration revives draft versions discarded before deletion and selects one as the current editable draft.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Code workflow action uses a function with configurable inputs and outputs. Closing or switching away from the Code action panel within its 500 ms save delay cancels a pending array edit.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The Code action holds local edits behind an unflushed 500 ms debounced callback. Unmounting the owner causes the pending callback to return without saving; unlike the passing sibling editor, cleanup does not flush the edit.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Code workflow action uses a function with configurable inputs and outputs. Closing or switching away from the Code action panel within its 500 ms save delay cancels a pending array edit.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Code workflow action uses a function with configurable inputs and outputs. Code action inputs declared as numeric arrays are edited and submitted as unrestricted strings. Numeric members lose their JSON number type, and nonnumeric members are accepted without the declared item-type validation.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Generic Code array rendering drops the inferred item schema and renders/commits members as unrestricted strings. Numeric literal members change JSON type, and nonnumeric members lack the validation required by the declared number[] schema.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Code workflow action uses a function with configurable inputs and outputs. Set up a Code action input declared as a list of numbers and edit its literal items. Numeric entries save as strings, and nonnumeric text is accepted without list-item validation; scalar number inputs provide the working type/validation controls.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Add another Else-if route to a conditional If/Else action. Newly added branch steps use updated positions while existing branch steps stay in their old locations, causing them to overlap in the open diagram. This concerns live diagram positioning after route insertion.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Route insertion computes and saves updated branch positions, but same-version mergeWorkflowDiagrams restores old positions for existing nodes. Only new nodes retain the newly computed placement.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s If/Else workflow step chooses between alternative paths based on conditions. Add another Else-if route to an If/Else workflow action. New branch heads use updated positions while existing branch heads stay put, so the visible step cards overlap.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s schedule trigger starts an automation at configured recurring times. Schedule validation messages show literal template placeholders such as {newHour}, {newMinute} or {newDay} instead of the value the user entered. The accepted failure is the unexpanded error message; it does not by itself establish that an invalid schedule executed.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Single quotes around interpolation variables escape ICU placeholders into literal text in compiled translation catalogs.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s schedule trigger starts an automation at configured recurring times. Enter an invalid minute, hour or day in the schedule editor. The validation message displays a literal template name such as {newHour} instead of the value that was entered.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. Returning to a previously opened Workflow Runs table can omit executions created while the table was away, even though its header count includes them. Waiting does not reconcile the cached rows; a new query is needed.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The header count refreshes with cache-and-network while the settled table uses cache-first. Re-registering the unmounted subscription supplies no snapshot of newly added records.
reproductionPaths: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. Leave a filtered Workflow Runs table, complete another matching execution in a second browser tab and return. The header count includes it but the row is absent even after waiting; the table keeps its earlier results.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s version picker lets a record list group records by their associated automation configuration. Group records by workflow version and open the group-selection picker. Versions belonging to different parent automations can all appear as the same short label, such as v1, without identifying their parent workflow. Users cannot distinguish which version they are choosing from those labels.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Versions have generated per-workflow names, version search uses their name rather than parent context, and generic option rendering exposes only that label.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s version picker lets a record list group records by their associated automation configuration. Workflow-version grouping options from different parent workflows display indistinguishable v1 names without parent context.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Code workflow action uses a function with configurable inputs and outputs. Define a Code action’s parameter type using a named type or interface in the same source file. The configurable input fields disappear and an empty input is saved; writing the equivalent type directly beside the parameter restores the fields. This is input-definition parsing, not an observed failure of completed function execution.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Input-schema inference resolves a small set of built-in named types but does not look up local type/interface declarations, falling back to an empty schema for the reference. This is a source-informed hypothesis; the exact mechanism has not been confirmed in execution.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Code workflow action uses a function with configurable inputs and outputs. Declare Code action parameters with a type or interface defined in the same source file rather than spelling the type inline. Configurable inputs disappear and the saved input becomes empty; equivalent inline type annotations restore them.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. The workflow variable picker returns no available steps for uppercase queries that match existing step names.
logicalBugs.rootCause: WorkflowVariablesDropdownSteps lowercases step.name but not raw query. Latest inspected source normalizes both.
reproductionPaths: Twenty can fill workflow inputs with entered values or references to a trigger or earlier step. The workflow variable picker returns no available steps for uppercase queries that match existing step names.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Code workflow action uses a function with configurable inputs and outputs. Expand a Code action editor to fullscreen and open a generated Boolean or enum input, which offers true/false or a fixed set of choices. The choice list is painted beneath the fullscreen editor and cannot be selected; it is not simply missing an option.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Select does not pass the above-modal flag to Dropdown. Its body-ported choice list uses stacking level 38 while the fullscreen editor uses level 40. The sibling variable picker explicitly requests the above-modal level.
reproductionPaths: Twenty’s Code workflow action uses a function with configurable inputs and outputs. Generated Boolean and enum input choices in the fullscreen workflow Code editor are hidden beneath its overlay and cannot be selected.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty saved views display records in a chosen layout and retain their configured settings. Changing a saved view’s layout, Group by field or column calculation can replace its currently applied but unsaved filters and sorts with the saved settings. The displayed record set changes even though the user changed presentation rather than asking to reset filtering. This includes Table/board transitions and Workflow Runs (execution history) grouping.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Changing layout/grouping calls useUpdateCurrentView, which reloads all index states from the previously saved currentView when grouping changes. The saved filters overwrite the active unsaved filters even though this action only changes presentation.
reproductionPaths: Twenty records each execution of an automation as a workflow run, with a Flow diagram and step details. Choosing Group by in a saved Workflow Runs view replaces its active unsaved filters with saved filters, silently changing which executions are shown.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. Duplicate a step and use its selected side-panel header to rename the copy. The panel body shows the new step but the header still targets the original, so the original is renamed instead. The unintended rename persists.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Duplication updates diagram selection to the created step but leaves sidePanelWorkflowStepId unchanged. The body resolves diagram selection, while the header resolves and saves the separate old side-panel step ID. Ordinary node opening synchronizes both IDs.
reproductionPaths: Twenty workflows are automations made of a starting trigger and connected action steps. Duplicate a workflow step and rename it through the newly selected step’s side-panel header. The body shows the copy but the header still targets the original, so the original step is renamed instead.

logicalBugs.description: Twenty’s Iterator action repeats its child steps for each item in a list. A finite Iterator placed directly after a manual trigger stops advancing when a loop Filter rejects an item, leaving its completed continuation unstarted and the saved execution Running.
logicalBugs.rootCause: After starting, Iterator eligibility checks all action parents and requires a successful one. The trigger is stored separately and does not supply such a parent.
